name: SIM Deal Brick
description: Test fixture: the deal brick compiled from the prompt-generator-deal golden prompt (two piles, shuffle-dealt, a writing step, a share-out). Underscore-prefixed so it never appears in game lists.

announce.message: We are building writing prompts together. You will add a person and a circumstance to the piles. Then the piles get shuffled and you will be dealt one of each, invented by classmates, to write from.

person.prompt: Name a person a story could be about. A lighthouse keeper, a substitute teacher on their first day, a retired spy who misses the work...

circumstance.prompt: Name a circumstance, something happening or about to happen. Stuck in an elevator, the last day of summer, a power cut in the middle of an exam...

share.message: One dealt hand at a time.

wrap.message: Every prompt in this room was built by three people. Keep yours, it is the start of something.
